name: VMS - Fulfillment, Assembly and Warehousing
old_description: Our mission here at VMS Inc., a 3PL and fulfillment provider, is to seamlessly connect businesses with tailored, efficient, and innovative service solutions. Through cutting-edge technology, unparalleled expertise, and a commitment to excellence, we aim to optimize supply chains, streamline operations, and enhance customer service and satisfaction. Together, we navigate challenges, deliver reliability, and create lasting partnerships that drive growth and success for our clients in an ever-evolving marketplace.
about:
VMS operates from a 12,000-square-foot facility in West Rutland, Vermont, conveniently located near major transportation routes to New York, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Maine, and Canada. The business has more than three decades of industry experience and was acquired by Jessica Dambrackas in 2011 when she purchased the former Rutland Industries, continuing a legacy of contract manufacturing, fulfillment, and packaging services.

The company provides a range of outsourced services including quality control, distribution, inventory management, kitting, packaging, assembly, pick-and-pack, e-commerce fulfillment, warehousing, and cross-docking. Its climate-controlled warehouse and loading docks accommodate various truck sizes, while specialized software integrates with e-commerce shopping carts for rapid order processing. The team handles everything from basic hand assembly to comprehensive offsite manufacturing and packaging divisions, operating under lean manufacturing principles.

VMS serves clients across diverse sectors such as electronics manufacturing, food packaging, e-commerce, fashion, and publishing. Notable customers have included the Rutland Herald for bundle distribution and startup companies requiring flexible warehousing and accurate order fulfillment. The company's clientele spans both large and small businesses seeking to reduce overhead and streamline supply chains.

A core differentiator is the company's social mission: Dambrackas established VMS to employ as many individuals with disabilities as possible, a commitment that guided the acquisition and remains central to operations. The firm also emphasizes fixed pricing to simplify expense forecasting and aims to lower clients' costs associated with advertising, training, payroll taxes, and benefits. This community-focused approach, combined with over 30 years of operational experience, positions VMS as a partner for businesses seeking reliable, cost-effective outsourcing.

name: Valley Woodcraft & Lumber Co
old_description: relationships. Our commitment to our promise is unparalleled.
about:
Valley Woodcraft & Lumber Co operates from Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1952. The company is a small, veteran-owned contract manufacturer that has remained under the same ownership since its inception.

The shop produces custom wood, phenolic, composite, and machined-plastic components and assembled products from customer prints. Its process capabilities include CAD/CAM design, CNC nested-based machining, drilling, finishing, profiling, sanding, shaping, mortise-and-tenon joinery, laminating, gluing, fingerjointing, paraffin treatment of lumber, and both commercial and mil-spec packaging. The facility handles everything from simple dimensional stock to complex assemblies, with a product portfolio that spans cable cleats, clamps, wedges, blocks, spacers, wheel chocks, floor panels, ladders, and hundreds of other precision parts.

Valley Woodcraft serves aerospace, defense, rail, transit, construction, maritime, furniture, and utility industries. Its AS9100 and ISO 9001 certifications cover the manufacture of high-precision machined parts for aviation, aerospace, transportation, and defense customers. Representative parts include cable fairleads, burnout sticks, switch wedges, phenolic pads, tunnel insulation, and structural components such as floor beams and bulkhead protectors.

The company emphasizes assured product quality, competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and the flexibility to fulfill any order size. Its veteran-owned status and dedicated team with advanced technology are cited as key differentiators, along with a commitment to superior customer service that has been maintained since 1952.

name: Valley Woodworkers
old_description: The Valley Woodworkers of West Virginia cares about our community and does what we can to improve it.  The mission of the Valley Woodworkers of West Virginia is twofold.  One part is the training of local community members to be woodworker. Whether it be honing their craft to later become a professional woodworker, or merely to create handcrafted heirloom pieces for their friends and family.  Secondly, since 1991, the Valley Woodworkers have been making heirloom quality wooden toys for the Salvation Army to distribute to underprivileged children at Christmas.
about:
Valley Woodworkers operates from Dunbar, West Virginia. The organization traces its roots to 1991 when members began crafting heirloom wooden toys for the Salvation Army’s Christmas distribution. The club was formally established in 2008 as a gathering point for woodworkers of all skill levels. It is a community-focused group supported by local sponsors such as Woodcraft and Withrow Supply.

The club’s activities center on woodworking education and charitable production. Members meet monthly at the clubhouse on 12th Street for show-and-tell sessions and demonstrations covering techniques such as dovetail joinery, band-saw box making, and cradle building. Since 1991, the group has produced wooden toys for underprivileged children at Christmas. The facility includes a shared workshop space, though specific equipment is not publicly listed.

Valley Woodworkers serves the local woodworking community—beginners, amateurs, and professionals—along with the Salvation Army as a charitable recipient. Sponsors include Woodcraft and Withrow Supply, which provide machinery, hardware, and finishing supplies. The club also partners with Clonch Industries, Inc., though the nature of the relationship is not detailed.

The organization’s stated mission is twofold: to train community members in woodworking, whether for professional development or personal fulfillment, and to continue the tradition of donating handcrafted toys to children in need. This community-service focus distinguishes it from commercial woodworking shops.

name: Valley Woodworks LLC
old_description: Most furniture is manufactured to be replaced. Engineered composites, spray-on finishes, metal fasteners hidden beneath a surface that mimics wood without being it. It looks fine on day one. By year three, it shows you exactly what it was.
about:
Valley Woodworks LLC was founded in 2022 by Jonathan Dias in Palmer, Massachusetts. Dias, a graduate of Springfield College with a degree in Business Administration and a minor in Entrepreneurial Studies, started the company after deciding he could not spend his career in an office. He began building furniture by hand with the goal of creating pieces that lacked the commercial, mass-produced feel of typical retail offerings.

The workshop produces custom tables and furniture on a commission basis. Each piece starts as a solid hardwood slab, hand-selected for grain, moisture content, and character. The company uses no veneers, plywood cores, or engineered composites. Finishes are hand-rubbed hardwax oils that protect the wood while leaving the grain visible and pores open. The process emphasizes handcrafted joinery and surface preparation rather than automated production.

Valley Woodworks serves residential clients seeking heirloom-quality furniture for their homes. Customers engage directly with the maker through a design consultation, resulting in one-of-a-kind dining tables, desks, and other pieces intended to anchor a living space for generations. The company does not sell through retailers or maintain inventory; every item is made to order.

Dias founded the business to counter what he describes as a click-to-buy culture that prioritizes speed over longevity. The stated mission is to keep the art of fine furniture making alive by delivering pieces that are passed down rather than replaced. The company’s differentiator is its commitment to solid-wood construction and transparent finishing that shows the material’s natural character.

Hand-rubbed hardwax oil finishes that preserve wood's natural grain and pores
Custom commission model with direct designer-maker collaboration
Founded to counter mass-produced, disposable furniture culture

name: Vault Furniture
old_description: As an American-made furniture company, we pride ourselves on providing a high quality product with great customer service. We offer a wide variety of furniture options, and we are always happy to work with customers to create the perfect custom solution for their space.
about:
Vault Furniture operates from Caldwell, Idaho, where it handcrafts furniture and home décor. The company was co-founded by Brandi, who serves as designer, though the founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces reclaimed-wood shelving units, wall-mounted desks, tables, benches, carts, vases, wine racks, pet feeders and mounting brackets. Every piece is made to order using reclaimed old-growth pine, sustainably sourced ash and black walnut, American steel and GREENGUARD-certified low-VOC finishes. Production takes place in the company’s Caldwell facility, where woodworking, metal fabrication and finishing are done by hand.

Vault Furniture sells directly to homeowners and works with interior designers and commercial clients seeking custom pieces. The catalog includes residential furniture and home accessories, with examples such as the Asymmetrical Side Table, Modern Industrial Coffee Table and vertical wall vases. The company also supplies shelf brackets and mounting hardware for DIY installations.

The business was started to create heirloom-quality furniture from sustainably sourced materials while providing exceptional customer service. Differentiators cited by the company include free design consultations with co-founder Brandi, free shipping in the contiguous United States, and a commitment to locally sourced, eco-friendly materials.

That’s why, as a family-owned business based right here in Las Vegas, we’ve made it our mission to deliver not just reliable medical supplies in Las Vegas, NV, but also personalized, responsive support that helps you or your loved ones stay comfortable, safe, and independent.
about:
Vegas Medical Supplies Corp is a family-owned medical equipment supplier headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was established with a mission to deliver reliable medical supplies and personalized, responsive support to customers throughout the region, emphasizing honesty, service, and trust as core values.

The company stocks a broad selection of durable medical equipment, including respiratory product categories and mobility aids such as wheelchairs and scooters. All devices stocked are medically approved and meet industry standards. Beyond product sales, the team operates a repair service, supplying replacement parts like batteries and armrests and providing troubleshooting assistance for mobility devices.

Vegas Medical Supplies serves healthcare professionals seeking dependable supply partners as well as individuals and caregivers in need of home medical equipment. Its customer base spans the Las Vegas metropolitan area, with an emphasis on fast local delivery and hands-on service. The team assists customers in selecting appropriate equipment for their specific needs.

The business was founded on the principle that an equipment provider should care as much about service as product quality, aiming to help customers maintain comfort, safety, and independence through attentive support.

about:
Vehicle Parts, operating as HQ 911, was founded in 1973 in Jefferson, Louisiana, serving the New Orleans metropolitan area. The company is a family-run business that began as an emergency equipment installer for public safety fleets.

The company designs, sells, and installs equipment for police, fire, and emergency medical service vehicles, with a specialization in lighting systems and full vehicle upfitting. It maintains an inventory of more than 25 brands covering products from warning lights and push bumpers to batteries, and provides repair and installation services from its facility on Deckbar Avenue.

Vehicle Parts serves law enforcement agencies, fire departments, and emergency medical service providers throughout the New Orleans region. Its customer base includes municipal and parish fleets requiring upfitting for patrol cars, fire apparatus, and ambulances.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure and a commitment to quality service at reasonable prices as the foundation of its operation.

name: Velmar Food Services
old_description: Velmar Food Services is an Arizona-based, family-owned Company. Home to the Arizona Gold brand, the Company has been perfecting the art of flavorful food since it was founded in 1974. Select spices, locally-produced tortillas, robust beans, cheese, green chiles and love for nutrition all go into making Arizona Gold the highest quality brand.
about:
Velmar Food Services operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it was founded in 1974 by Richard and Judith Barton. The company began with recipes developed by Richard's father, a culinary craftsman who created the perfect burrito, and initially served mobile food services before expanding to supply unified school districts across Arizona and California. Now a third-generation family-run business, Velmar remains headquartered at 4420 N. 42nd Avenue in Phoenix.

The company manufactures its own Arizona Gold brand of Mexican cuisine — including burritos, beans, cheese, green chiles, fresh eggs and choice meats — using locally produced tortillas and select spices. In addition to manufacturing, Velmar provides foodservice distribution of top-label brands to restaurants, delis, convenience stores, healthcare facilities and correctional operations. Its facilities include a large warehouse and freezer space that it also leases to other food businesses for pallet storage, helping them manage seasonal demand spikes.

Velmar's customer base spans restaurants, delis, convenience stores, healthcare facilities, correctional operations and school districts. The company specifically notes supplying unified school districts across Arizona and California with its Arizona Gold products, which have become a favorite among students while meeting nutritional requirements.

Velmar emphasizes authentic, culturally rooted flavors and product innovation while minimizing cost to the consumer. The company says its passion for food combined with a focus on helping customers succeed sets it apart from ordinary distributors, offering a single source for beverages, pastas, exclusive brands, beef, poultry and seafood. It also highlights community involvement through sponsorships of local charities in the Phoenix Valley.

name: Velocity Metalworks
old_description: Our precision machining capabilities use the latest CNC and Electronic Discharge (EDM) techniques, to handle complex and intricate shapes on components large or small.
about:
Velocity Metalworks operates from two Illinois locations, with its headquarters in Hoffman and a second facility in Belleville. The company was founded in 1970 and has spent over five decades building a reputation in tool & die, metal stamping, fabrication, and contract manufacturing. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop delivers a full suite of metalworking services, including CNC machining, EDM, stamping, punching, fabrication, coating and finishing (paint, powder coating, polishing), and assembly. It also provides engineering, design, and prototyping support, positioning itself as a total supply-chain partner from concept through delivery. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Velocity serves tier 1 and OEM manufacturers in demanding industries, though the company does not list specific sectors by name. Its customer base consists of original equipment manufacturers that require precision metal components and tooling for high-stakes applications.

The company's stated mission is to manufacture metal solutions so customers who value "Made in America" can compete and win. It emphasizes a quality-first culture backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification, a lean mindset to reduce cost, and a commitment to responsive, personal communication throughout every project phase.

about:
Vergent Products is headquartered in Loveland, Colorado. The company was founded in 1995 on two core principles: exceptional client experience and the engagement of a diverse team of experts focused on continually elevating client success.

Vergent Products provides end-to-end electronics design and manufacturing services from its self-described facility in Loveland. Capabilities span product design (electrical, mechanical, firmware/software), PCB assembly with multiple SMT lines, robotic selective solder, automated optical inspection, X-ray inspection, functional and in-circuit testing, box build, system integration, configure-to-order, warranty and repair, and supply chain services including advanced component stocking, 3PL distribution, and direct order fulfillment. The company operates a 100% digital factory with integrated ERP, PDM, and MES systems, enabling full traceability and a proprietary preventive quality system.

The company serves customers in medical devices, measurement and controls, industrial and critical environment, aerospace and defense, energy generation and alternative energy, and automotive electrical systems.

Vergent Products emphasizes an unparalleled dedication to client relationships, promising accountability across the full product lifecycle. Its stated differentiators include unsurpassed on-time delivery, a 100% digital factory with full traceability, integrated ERP/PDM/MES, a proprietary preventive quality system, and advanced component stocking with real-time risk mitigation. In 2026 the company received the Manufacturer Community Outreach Award from Manufacturer's Edge and the Colorado Manufacturing Network.
